entries.zh: 随便；悉听尊便，想怎么做就怎么做
entries.en: do as you please; whatever you like; at one's discretion
as one wishes; do what you will
entries.notes: 汉字第二字原件难辨（标[疑:院/阮]），据西语 haz lo que quieras 与闽南语栏合定「随人所愿」义

entries.en: at will; as one pleases; of one's own accord
up to you; as you decide; at your disposal
it is your own affair; do as you see fit
according to your own judgment; as you decide

entries.zh: 大蜡烛；（宗教仪式用的）白蜡大烛
entries.en: large wax candle; processional candle of wax
to flatter; to fawn upon; to curry favor

entries.notes: 汉字栏[空]，西语词头「Halion, amederagiñ」拼写难解，闽南语栏「Lay hi gubilan」音节无法对识，语义无从定夺
汉字「打」与闽南语栏均指击打，与西语词头 Hallar（寻获）义不合，疑词头有抄误，释义从汉、闽两栏

entries.en: to find what is lost; to recover a lost thing

entries.zh: 遇上好机会；碰到便利时机
entries.en: to find a good opportunity; to light upon a favorable occasion

entries.zh: 寻得踪影；发现某事的迹象
entries.en: to find traces or signs of something; to get wind of it
entries.notes: 首字标[疑:扔/拐]难辨，据西语 indicios 与闽南语栏次音节（影）取「踪迹/迹象」义

entries.en: to find and pick up; to take up what is found
